_michael_roos_01: After 2 days of war, R-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Teodor Roos.
Teodor Roos and Otto Elitecelebs carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Teodor Roos won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-F19. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Rain all night. Teodor Roos bailed water out of R-F19 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Teodor Roos helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Pavel "Crow" Hayden and Teodor Roos argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Rematch. Teodor Roos lost everything he won, plus a pressed cornflower. The whole dugout watched.
Teodor Roos made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Teodor Roos won back a pressed cornflower and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
adamjedlicka28: Hugo Adamjedlicka found a place in R-S12 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd and Hugo Adamjedlicka both swear they saw a ghost at Blackwater Canal. Each says the other screamed first.
Hugo Adamjedlicka got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
cowardlygaming1412: In Varenne, Konrad "Smokes" Cowardlygami was a medical student. In S-R16, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again.
demirkeskin06: Isidor "Owl" Demirkeskin came up the line with a tin of tobacco and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
dvic33: They issued Matthias "Hollow" Dvic a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Matthias "Hollow" Dvic lay in the ruins of Hill 304 from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory.
finn__thehuman___: Day 6. The corporal put Walter Thehuman beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Walter Thehuman tried to describe the smell of Greyhallow and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. A letter from home found Walter Thehuman before the night shift. Walter Thehuman folded it small and kept it close.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Walter Thehuman was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Walter Thehuman taught Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Walter Thehuman backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.
han.ethan_fish: On Day 9 Henrik "Button" Fish took a post at R-R12 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He keeps feeding the rats, and the men liked him for it.
haydnburrell_9thky: Dietrich Thky told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Dietrich Thky opened a parcel addressed in an unfamiliar hand. Inside was a note explaining that the usual letter writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Dietrich Thky looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dietrich Thky cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Dietrich Thky talks to his rifle. Today, under fire at Sorrow Copse, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F16.

Wiring party. Dietrich Thky held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F16, and everyone came back. Dietrich Thky had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Clement "Lucky" Johnrant crossed it, Dietrich Thky fired. Clement "Lucky" Johnrant was badly wounded. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Dietrich Thky wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at Hill 304. Dietrich Thky fired. Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Dietrich Thky fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bram Eccentricred, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Dietrich Thky fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at S-F16. Before dawn Norbert Bwk walked into it, grazed. Dietrich Thky was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F16. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Dietrich Thky fell at S-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj).
Valentin Thky arrived carrying the family name of Dietrich Thky. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Oskar "Spark" Person and Valentin Thky made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
henri.hakkinen.566: The draft reached S-F17 on Day 3. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Arno "Crow" Hakkinen fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Emil Theramblingb, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F17. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen has learned to walk bent double.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen cut Jonas "Mole" Biesc's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Bram Archiegregor fixed the strap on Arno "Crow" Hakkinen's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen tried to describe the smell of Port Abel and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
joshgentile80: Quentin Joshgentile, a ferryman from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 4 to fill a gap in R-F3. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Quentin Joshgentile fired at a movement across the wire at R-F3. The man went down: Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin, grazed.

Quentin Joshgentile had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Florian Wubbarn crossed it, Quentin Joshgentile fired. Florian Wubbarn was grazed. After the loss of Hill 304, Quentin Joshgentile helped stack spare sandbags at R-F3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Quentin Joshgentile found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
A bullet found Quentin Joshgentile at R-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).
Quentin Joshgentile never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Quentin Joshgentile's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
slade_2233: Day 4. The corporal put Cyril "Ash" Slade beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The new duty roster listed Cyril "Ash" Slade as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Cyril "Ash" Slade pulled Jakub Mccooper out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home reached Cyril "Ash" Slade before dusk. Cyril "Ash" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Cyril "Ash" Slade fired at a movement across the wire at S-F3. The man went down: Quentin Khattabka, gravely wounded. The barrage caught Cyril "Ash" Slade in the open at S-F3. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit S-F3 took Cyril "Ash" Slade with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.

Dietrich "Button" Slade joined S-F3 under the shadow of Cyril "Ash" Slade's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Dietrich "Button" Slade's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich "Button" Slade watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A clear shot from S-F3. Dietrich "Button" Slade gravely wounded Bram "Bones" Hop and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home reached Dietrich "Button" Slade before dusk. Dietrich "Button" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich "Button" Slade wrote a letter for Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer's mother, because Smokes could not find the words. Smokes signed it. A letter from home reached Dietrich "Button" Slade before dusk. Dietrich "Button" Slade read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich "Button" Slade was carrying water up to S-F3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Dietrich "Button" Slade did not. Shot by Felix "Tin" Singh of the Concord (@jasmandeep_singh999).
No bed for Dietrich "Button" Slade yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
